items.rationale: Sections 2.3.3 and 4.2.2 cover atmospheric surge damage to pre-existing fixed AC; this wording does not exclude kitchen units. The surge source and fire-group election are unconfirmed; if covered, §7.1.10 limits the replacement to the pre-loss specification, estimated at €1,413 gross.

Under §§7.1.1 and 7.1.11, necessary installation and wiring checks for covered replacement equipment are repair costs. The €480 gross estimate is for one ordinary installation charge; any work on unrelated equipment must be separated under §9.5.

Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.9–7.1.10 allow €61 gross for an equivalent console if replacement of the existing mount was necessary for reinstatement. The description establishes that one unit used a console, but not that the console was damaged or could not be reused.
Under §7.1.11, ordinary freight follows the covered replacement, estimated at €43 gross for one shipment. Any freight attributable to non-covered equipment must be apportioned.
